from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, Optional

class Company(BaseModel):
    """A company from one financial report, with name and assigned category."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The company's full legal name as reported")
    stock_abbreviation: Optional[str] = Field(description="The company's stock abbreviation if available")
    category: Optional[Literal["包含航空", "包含生物", "包含洁", "包含科技", "其他公司"]] = Field(description="Which category this company belongs to based on name keywords")
    financial_summary: Optional[str] = Field(description="Brief summary of key financial figures (revenue, net income, etc.)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[Company]
